title: In 2018, billionaire pharma heir Frank Binder paid $33 million for a Hollywood Hills mansion
summary_full: Frank Binder lists his Hollywood Hills mansion for thirty-five million dollars.  He bought the property eight years ago for thirty-three million dollars.  Binder is now focusing on his Ulyssia mega-yacht project.  This ambitious project involves a two-billion-dollar floating residential community.  The yacht is expected to begin sailing in the year twenty thirty.
